hooks.name: supplaiguard-verify-after-remediation
hooks.description: After a write tool modifies files (e.g. a remediation edit), request verification that findings are truly resolved.

action.prompt: Files were just modified. If this was a SupplAIGuard remediation, run the supplaiguard-verification agent to re-check the affected findings against the modified workspace. A finding is only resolved if the re-check no longer reports it; never treat a file edit alone as resolution. Report PASS/FAIL/NEEDS_REVIEW and any regressions.
